_comment: Miloosh Social Media Operating System — the deterministic execution config that ChatGPT-as-strategist (or the owner) edits to steer the system without touching channel code. lib/social/strategy.ts loads and validates this. Every field here is read by the content engine, the QA gates, or the publish orchestrator — nothing here is decorative.
_channelsComment: ROAD TO THE FIRST 1,000 REAL HUMANS mission (2026-08-22) Phase 3 finding: bluesky and mastodon were marked enabled but have never had real credentials in Vercel production (confirmed via `vercel env ls` -- no SOCIAL_BLUESKY_*/SOCIAL_MASTODON_* vars exist at all) -- every real publish attempt on both channels has failed with 'missing env' since launch, generating content variants that could never actually distribute. Disabled here until the owner supplies real credentials; re-enable by flipping these back to true once SOCIAL_BLUESKY_HANDLE/SOCIAL_BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD or SOCIAL_MASTODON_BASE_URL/SOCIAL_MASTODON_ACCESS_TOKEN are actually set in Vercel. facebook and linkedin are both confirmed working with real verified posts.

cadence._comment: Posts per 7-day week, per channel. Conservative on purpose — Phase 7 explicitly says start conservative to avoid spam signals. A channel with cadence 0 is prepared but not scheduled.

pillarWeights._comment: Buyer-question-first mix. Relative weight, not a percentage. Prioritize real decision, pricing, alternatives, migration and buyer-education questions over company-centric announcements.

campaignPriorities: Wix is now an approved, active monetization partner (Impact.com, 4 funnels: Website Builder, Domain, Headless, eCommerce) — prioritize genuinely relevant Wix content where editorially justified: Wix vs Squarespace, Wix vs Shopify, website builder buying advice, Wix Headless for AI-assisted development, domain-selection guides. Never insert the affiliate link directly into a social post — link to the relevant Miloosh page; the page itself resolves the correct funnel.

ElevenLabs is an approved, active monetization partner (PartnerStack) — eligible commercial-content candidate: ElevenLabs alternatives, AI voice/text-to-speech/voice-cloning comparisons, pricing research, use-case guides, ElevenLabs vs competitors. If tagging @elevenlabsio on a platform where that handle is valid, only do so for a genuinely relevant post — never gratuitously, and never implying ElevenLabs endorses Miloosh.

affiliateDisclosurePolicy.text: Some links are affiliate links — we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. This never affects our rankings or comparisons.
